Dark Matters: VAE-Aware HDR Encoding for SDR-to-HDR Video Reconstruction SDR-to-HDR reconstruction is an ill-posed problem in which clipped highlights, crushed shadows, and quantization artifacts must be recovered while preserving the original content.
